notes: Transcribed from the hand-written surfaces, not re-derived: serialize()/read() in Frame.h/Frame.cpp, the dataset row builders in ProjectEditorForms.cpp, the commit sub-appliers in ProjectEditorCommit.cpp, and applyDataset*Fields in ProjectHandlerEntities.cpp.
jsonKey names a Keys:: constant identifier; the literal spelling lives only in Frame.h.

Two declared defect fixes carry a 'defect' marker and describe the TARGET state, not today's behaviour: overviewDisplay is now serialized, and the read-side defaults for fftSamples/fftSamplingRate/ledHigh/index match the struct initializers.
value and numericValue are runtime values that today's serializer still writes into the document; they stay persist:always so project files round-trip byte-identically.

datasetWidgets.notes: Order is QMap key order (m_datasetWidgets), not insertion order. Installed dataset-scope widget extension packages (spec 0038) are appended after these rows, so a machine with no package installed sees exactly this domain and no stored index moves.

plotOptions.notes: Order is QMap key order (m_plotOptions, keyed by QPair<plt,log>).

fftSampleCounts.notes: m_fftSamples; labels are the numbers themselves and are never translated. Not-found falls back to index 7 (1024).

fftWindows.notes: m_fftWindows / m_fftWindowValues; values are SerialStudio::FFTWindow. Not-found falls back to Blackman-Harris (5).

widgetExtensionOptions.notes: Appends the installed dataset-scope widget extension packages to the built-in widget domain (spec 0038 T20 residue); a package that replaces a built-in keeps the built-in row.

properties.label: Dataset Title
properties.description: Name of the dataset, used for labeling and identification

properties.label: Computed Dataset
properties.description: Computed datasets compute their value from transforms and shared variables, they do not require a frame index

properties.label: Hide on Dashboard
properties.description: Suppress this dataset's standalone dashboard tile; the canvas widget can still read its values

properties.label: Frame Index
properties.description: Frame position used for aligning datasets in time
properties.apiError: Invalid index: must be >= 0 (0 = unassigned, 1+ = parser slot)
properties.defect: read-default was -1 while the struct initializes 0; the manifest default is the struct value

properties.label: Measurement Unit
properties.description: Unit of measurement, such as volts or amps (optional)

properties.label: Script Alias
properties.description: Stable name for getDataset-style script/API lookups; must be unique (optional)
properties.apiError: Alias '%1' is already used by another dataset; aliases must be unique across the project

properties.label: Widget Color
properties.description: Custom display color for this dataset; automatic uses the theme palette
properties.apiError: Invalid color '%1': use '#rrggbb' or a valid color name; empty string restores the automatic theme color

properties.label: Minimum Value
properties.description: Lower bound of the dataset value range; widgets and FFT fall back to it when their own range is left unset

properties.label: Maximum Value
properties.description: Upper bound of the dataset value range; widgets and FFT fall back to it when their own range is left unset

properties.label: Enable Plot Widget
properties.description: Plot data in real-time
properties.notes: One combo row drives both plt and log; the row's form id is kDatasetView_Plot.

properties.apiDescription: Include this dataset in CSV/data logging
properties.notes: No row of its own: edited through the Plt tuple row.

properties.label: X-Axis Source
properties.description: Choose Time or a dataset to drive the X-Axis in plots

properties.label: Logarithmic X Axis
properties.description: Scale the X axis in decades; available when the X-Axis source is Samples or a dataset (not Time)

properties.label: Logarithmic Y Axis
properties.description: Scale the Y axis in decades; values at or below zero are clamped

properties.label: Enable FFT Analysis
properties.description: Perform frequency-domain analysis of the dataset

properties.label: Enable Waterfall Plot
properties.description: Show a scrolling spectrogram of frequency content over time (Pro)

properties.label: Peak Ballistics
properties.description: Analyzer-style display: peaks rise instantly and decay smoothly over the release time

properties.label: Ballistics Release (ms)
properties.description: Decay time for the ballistics display (50-5000 ms)

properties.label: Waterfall Y Axis
properties.description: Choose Time (default) or any dataset whose value drives the Y axis -- produces a Campbell diagram when bound to e.g. RPM

properties.label: FFT Window Size
properties.description: Number of samples used for each FFT calculation window
properties.defect: read-default was -1 while the struct initializes 256; the manifest default is the struct value

properties.label: FFT Window Function
properties.description: Window applied before the transform to reduce spectral leakage; affects both the FFT plot and the waterfall
properties.notes: Read side clamps an out-of-range value back to 5 (Blackman-Harris).

properties.label: FFT Sampling Rate (Hz, required)
properties.description: Sampling frequency used for FFT (in Hz)
properties.defect: read-default was -1 while the struct initializes 100; the manifest default is the struct value

properties.label: Logarithmic Frequency Axis
properties.description: Scale the frequency axis in decades so low octaves stay readable; applies to both the FFT plot and the waterfall

properties.label: Minimum Value (optional)
properties.description: Lower bound for data normalization; falls back to the dataset value range when left unset

properties.label: Maximum Value (optional)
properties.description: Upper bound for data normalization; falls back to the dataset value range when left unset

properties.label: Widget
properties.description: Select the visual widget used to display this dataset

properties.label: Tick Count
properties.description: Major-tick count on the dial scale (0 = auto-fit to widget size)

properties.label: Label Format
properties.description: Decimal places or notation used on tick labels and the value display

properties.label: Decimal Points
properties.description: Fixed decimal places for the value display; overrides the format (-1 = auto)
properties.notes: The editor row is always editable and clamps at -1 only; the API additionally caps at 15.

properties.label: Minimum Value (optional)

properties.label: Maximum Value (optional)

properties.label: Hold Min/Max Markers

properties.label: Show in LED Panel
